No crash. No roadwork. So why are you stuck in traffic?
In 2008, researchers put twenty-two cars on an empty circle and gave one instruction: drive steady.
Somewhere, one driver eased off. Just a little.
The car behind braked harder. The next one, harder still.
Within minutes, cars were stopping. On an empty road.
And the strangest part? The jam moves backward. Full video on the channel.
